# S361 — Local roles: progress note in the run dir; read-only commands on own files allowed

Owner decisions 2026-11-14 (relay session 8d711f67, chat "Yes"): a local role's progress note lives in the run's state dir, `~/.local/state/ork/runs/RUN/tmp/progress-ROLE.md` (adj 347, supersedes 336); a read-only role may write only that file (adj 348, supersedes 343); the approval point allows read-only commands on the role's own temp dir, report path and progress note without asking the owner (adj 349).

## Why

`docs/state.md:25` says nothing is written inside a project except what git and slicer write for a slice. `.scratch/` is this repo's convention only: slicer and sluice have no ignore or exclude rule for it, so the note would show as untracked and a landing or `git add -A` could commit it. The run dir already holds the role's temp dir and report (`docs/state.md:16-19`), outlives the worktree, and is redacted as one set. The two trial questions were reads of paths the brief itself assigns (`internal/engine/brief.go:95,125`); asking the owner for them adds no oversight.
